errors.evidence: The largest 67% slice is labeled in the figure as “域外汉籍研究集刊”, not “文史哲”. “文史哲” appears as a small category in the legend, not the dominant slice.
The machine text says “医图书馆建设”, but the figure legend shows “图书馆建设” (without the leading character).

errors.evidence: The figure’s legend is split across both sides, but the left side does not show the same set of labels as the right side; describing both sides as listing all slice labels is inaccurate.

The description states the chart is the distribution of the top twenty journals, but it does not identify the figure as showing the journal publication count distribution (“刊文量前二十期刊分布图”) as indicated by the caption/reference.

The reference notes that all slices are labeled with percentages, but the description does not mention that all 20 wedges have percentage annotations; it only gives a few labels and says others are below 7%.
